label: current-postgres-supplement
script:
set -eu
uname -r
for module in IO::Compress IO::Compress::Gzip Archive::Tar; do
 perl -e 'my $m=shift;my $f=$m;$f =~ s!::!/!g;$f.=".pm";eval{require $f};if($@){print "$m ABSENT error=$@"}else{no strict "refs";print "$m PRESENT version=",${$m."::VERSION"}," file=",$INC{$f},"\n"}' "$module"
done
ls -la /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
